## Personality

Blunt, wry and tireless; she has an opinion about everyone's knots.

## Story

Agna has mended the coves' nets for fifty years and remembers when the sea was calm enough to fish at night. Lately she finds nets torn by something with teeth far bigger than any fish she knows.
